headlines.description: Donald Brown ran for two touchdowns, Andrew Luck added another and the Indianapolis Colts rallied yet again, this time beating the Tennessee Titans 30-27 on Thursday night after trailing 14-0 in the first quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts erase early deficit, rally past Titans

events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Jairus Byrd had two interceptions in leading a Buffalo Bills defense that forced four turnovers in a 37-14 win over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills rattle Smith in blowout win over Jets

headlines.description: Robbie Gould kicked a 38-yard field goal to lift the Chicago Bears to a 23-20 victory over Baltimore Sunday in a game delayed about two hours by a torrential downpour.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears withstand Ravens, weather for OT win

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw two touchdown passes and Cincinnati returned a blocked punt and a fumble for touchdowns during a 31-point second quarter that set a Bengals record and swept the AFC North leaders to a 40-21 victory over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton, Bengals bounce back to rout Browns

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw for 298 yards and ran for a touchdown, LeSean McCoy had two TDs rushing and the Philadelphia Eagles snapped a 10-game home losing streak with a 24-16 victory over the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles hold off Redskins to claim first place

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger passed for 367 yards and four touchdowns, including two in the final 5 minutes as the Pittsburgh Steelers rallied to beat the Detroit Lions 37-27 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big Ben, Steelers edge Lions with 2 late TDs

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Bobby Rainey rushed for 163 yards and scored three touchdowns Sunday to lead the Tampa Bay Buccaneers to a 41-28 victory over the struggling Atlanta Falcons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs breathe easy with blowout of Falcons

headlines.description: Carson Palmer threw for 419 yards and two scores and did not throw an interception for the first time all year, leading the Arizona Cardinals to a 27-14 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer near flawless as Cards dispatch Jags

headlines.description: Matt McGloin leads Raiders over Texans, 28-23.
headlines.shortLinkText: McGloin helps Raiders spoil Kubiak's return

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Miami held San Diego without a touchdown over the final three quarters, and Brent Grimes broke up Philip Rivers' final pass in the end zone as time expired, giving the embattled Dolphins a 20-16 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins close out Chargers, snap slump

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Marques Colston capped a record-setting day with a 20-yard reception to get the Saints into field goal range, and Garrett Hartley kicked a 31-yarder as time expired, lifting New Orleans to a 23-20 victory over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hartley kicks Saints to late win over Niners

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New York Giants

headlines.description: Defensive end Jason Pierre-Paul scored on a spectacular, leaping 24-yard fourth-quarter interception return and the resurgent New York Giants won their fourth game in a row with a 27-13 victory over the slumping and injured-riddled Green Bay Packers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants pull past Packers to win 4th in a row

headlines.description: Seahawks top Vikes 41-20 for 13th straight at home
headlines.shortLinkText: Harvin debuts for Seahawks in record win

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Peyton Manning went virtually untouched by Kansas City's sack-happy defense Sunday night, throwing for 323 yards and a touchdown to lead the Denver Broncos to a 27-17 victory over the NFL's last undefeated team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning, Broncos hand Chiefs first defeat

events.name: New England Patriots at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw a 25-yard touchdown pass to Ted Ginn Jr. with 59 seconds left, and the Carolina Panthers held off the New England Patriots 24-20 on Monday night for their sixth straight victory when officials picked up a penalty flag on the final play.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers get past Pats in controversial finish
